description: This dataset from VIDA merges Google's Open Buildings version 3 with Microsoft's latest building footprints into one layer of 2,579,035,323 footprints, divided into 185 partitions, with each footprint labelled with its source. It is published on Source Cooperative, a Radiant Earth project, in cloud-native geospatial formats: GeoParquet, FlatGeobuf and PMTiles. The repository was created on 15 September 2023 and last updated on 21 August 2025, and it served about 26.9 million downloads and 36.5 TB in the 28 days before 26 September 2026. Coverage: the union of the Google and Microsoft coverage areas, global in practice. Access: public files on Source Cooperative, with an Observable notebook and VIDA's platform to explore them. Licence: follows the licences of the two sources, as explained in the README; free. Caveats: both inputs are machine-learning detections with their own errors and dates, and overlaps were resolved by a merging rule described in the README. Simulation uses are a single global footprint layer for exposure in flood, heat and earthquake risk studies, especially where national data are lacking. Related records: Google Open Buildings and Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints.
